inputs.name: suricata_series
inputs.description: Suricata release series to install from OISF's repositories. Hosts get the latest release in it and keep up with it on upgrades.

inputs.name: interfaces
inputs.description: Network interfaces Suricata watches with AF_PACKET, such as ["eth0"] or ["ens3", "ens4"]. When empty, the interface each host's default IPv4 route leaves by.

inputs.name: home_net
inputs.description: Networks Suricata treats as yours, HOME_NET in its rules. Everything else is EXTERNAL_NET.

inputs.name: rule_sources
inputs.description: suricata-update sources to enable, such as ["et/open", "oisf/trafficid"]. suricata-update list-sources shows them all.

inputs.name: custom_rules
inputs.description: Your own rules, one per item, such as ["alert dns any any -> any any (msg:\"Lookup of example.org\"; dns.query; content:\"example.org\"; nocase; sid:1000001; rev:1;)"].
